relationships.subject: HIF-2α
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF-2α arranges itself in heterodimers with ARNTL and employs complementary pathways (IHH and RUNX2) to directly stimulate the expression of certain members of the MMP family

relationships.subject: m6A modification
relationships.evidence_quote: The m6A alteration at the cellular level modulates the expression of ALP, Runx2, Osterix, VEGF, and other associated genes, influencing physiological processes.

key_findings: Review of six RNA modifications (m6A, m1A, m5C, m7G, ac4C, Ψ) regulating synovial homeostasis in RA.
HIF-2α activity overshadows protective HIF-1α, breaking down synovial homeostasis.
